description: CsNaTiO₃ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Cmcm space group. Cs is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four equivalent O atoms. There are two shorter (2.93 Å) and two longer (3.05 Å) Cs-O bond lengths. Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are four shorter (2.41 Å) and one longer (2.53 Å) Na-O bond length. Ti is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There is one shorter (1.77 Å) and four longer (1.99 Å) Ti-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four equivalent Cs, one Na, and one Ti atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Ti atoms.
